text: Curriculum content is authored as an outline (content/pathway/outline.json: goals, outcomes, modules, units, lesson entries with purpose, reading, teaches, requires, outcomes, sections, check intents) and whole-lesson files (content/pathway/lessons/<id>.md) with section anchors and checks inline; scripts/compile-pathway.mjs validates both and merges them into the runtime catalog
rationale: Implements owner decisions curriculum.authoring, content.anchoring, and learning.games checks-inline
